checks.reason: Matches the hub base diameter (100mm) plus 2x the 15mm blade protrusion.
Total height of the impeller correctly matches the design brief.
Continuous central bore hole found at R=7.5mm spanning from Z=0 to Z=60.
Inner radial boundary of the blades at the base measured ~49.9mm.
Radial boundary of the hub at Z=59.9 measured 15.05mm.
Detected 7 uniformly spaced blade peaks at mid-height (Z=30).
Blades extend to R=65.0mm from the R=50.0mm base hub.
Blades extend to R=20.1mm from the R=15.0mm top hub.
Measured angular twist of the blades across the Z-axis, extrapolating to ~57.5 degrees over 60mm.
Horizontal slice chord width at Z=30 is ~2.74mm, corresponding to a 2mm perpendicular wall thickness when accounting for the twist angle.

anomalies: At the very base of the model (Z=0 to roughly Z=2), there is an unexpected solid outer rim at R=65mm. Instead of individual blades protruding into open air, the base forms a solid enclosed disk containing 7 hollow cutouts representing the space between the blades. Above Z=2, the solid outer rim vanishes and the blades become properly isolated.
engineer_summary: The 3D model exceptionally captures all the complex geometry detailed in the prompt. The truncated conical hub tapers precisely from 100mm to 30mm with a through 15mm central bore hole. The 7 aerodynamic blades sweep correctly along the cone, uniformly twisting by roughly 58 degrees from top to bottom, with perfectly tapering outward protrusions (15mm at the base to 5mm at the top). The entire solid is fully unified. The only geometric anomaly is a thin, 2mm-tall solid outer retaining rim at the very base, which may be a minor artifact from how CadQuery executed the bottom blade sweep boolean operations.
